cache.coldDescription: Prompt cache is cold (the 1h TTL expired). The next turn will pay for the prefix again, and any pending context changes will be adopted during that turn at no extra cost.
cache.coldTurnsDescription: Number of turns in this session that paid for the cache prefix again, excluding the first turn. Open that message's debug panel to see why.
cache.warmDescription: Prompt cache is warm. A turn sent now can reuse the cached prefix at lower cost. The prefix will be written again after the timer expires.

cacheBreak.coldPrefixSize: Size of the prefix paid again as cold input

headline.model-changed: Model changed — the prompt cache prefix was rewritten
headline.prompt-or-tools-changed: System prompt or tool schema changed — the cache prefix was broken

cacheBreak.modelChangedDetail: The cache belongs to the model. Changing models inevitably rewrites the prefix, so frequent model changes incur this cost each time.
cacheBreak.refreshSuccess: Context refreshed. The next turn will freeze the current prompt and tool schemas.
cacheBreak.suspiciousDetail: With prompt epoch enabled, this break should not happen in the middle of a session: snapshot changes are held until an explicit refresh. Prompt epoch may be disabled for this workspace, or a path may be bypassing the snapshot (Settings → Workspace → “Prompt epoch”).
